pages.raw_title: About Our Unified Commerce Company | NCR Voyix
pages.raw_meta: NCR Voyix is a platform-powered leader in unified commerce for retail and restaurants. 140+ years of industry expertise powering modern shopping and dining.
raw_blocks: Accelerating new possibilities in commerce

Modern unified commerce for shopping and dining, backed by decades of industry know-how. We get retail. We get restaurants. We exist to empower you to accelerate new possibilities in your operations and experiences.
Built to innovate where it matters most

NCR Voyix innovates with purpose, guided by the realities of retail and restaurant operations, not just emerging technology trends. Our approach combines platform-powered flexibility, deep retail and restaurant DNA, modern software architecture and a focus on real outcomes.

The Voyix Commerce Platform brings together restaurant and retail applications, intelligent app delivery and management, and open platform enablers, empowering you to scale when and how your business demands.
Simplify transactions and reduce complexity with flexible and scalable payment processing. Manage orders with end-to-end payments built for fast-paced retail and restaurant environments.

No matter where you are on your implementation journey, our experts are there every step of the way. Our services teams are committed to helping you maximize the value of your technology, whether or not it’s ours.

From POS and payments to self-service and back-of-house, our hardware portfolio supports critical workflows across retail and restaurants, and is engineered for durability and reliability in fast-paced, high-volume environments.
Bringing our platform story to life

The NCR Voyix Customer Experience Center (CEC) is where our technology moves from slideware to real-world execution. Located at our Global Headquarters in Atlanta, the CEC is designed to help customers and prospects experience our solutions the same way they operate their business every day. On the floor, behind the counter, and across real workflows.

Instead of static demos, the CEC features immersive environments that mirror modern retail and restaurant operations. This allows teams to quickly see how our platform, applications, and services work together in practice. Not in theory.
Read more about the CEC
$1.4T in annual transaction volume*
#1 POS and self-checkout software provider
140 years of retail & restaurant innovation
6.5+ million devices supported annually
A legacy of leadership. A future built on modernization.

NCR Voyix has a long history of supporting some of the world's most iconic brands. For decades, we've helped businesses run their mission-critical operations, earning trust through reliability, scale and industry expertise.
What's changed is how we deliver that value.

We've modernized our technology and our mindset. Today, we pair our proven business logic with modern software approaches and end-to-end services that enable faster change, greater flexibility and a clearer path forward.
The foundation remains the same: deep expertise, customer focus and operational excellence. What's new is the speed, agility and innovation we bring to help our customers shape what's next.
At NCR Voyix, our values reflect how we show up for our customers, our partners and each other. They guide how we innovate, how we make decisions and how we deliver results.
We bring our values to life through I.D.E.A.: four action-oriented principles that link our innovation legacy with the future we're shaping.
Build what's next. Innovation is at the heart of NCR Voyix. We challenge the status quo, turn ideas into action and create solutions that make a meaningful impact.
Put customers first. We take ownership and follow through. From big bets to daily execution, we focus on outcomes that matter, moving with urgency, accountability and a bias toward action.
Win together. We believe the best results come from collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, share ideas openly and work as one team.
Make it happen. We stay flexible, anticipate needs and respond quickly to our customers, embracing new opportunities to drive growth and results.
Build a career with a global impact
Join a team that’s building the future of commerce. Help retail and restaurant innovators accelerate what’s next and unlock the next step in your career path.

pages.raw_title: Technology Solutions for Modern Commerce Leaders | NCR Voyix
pages.raw_meta: Empower your technology teams to modernize legacy systems, deploy microservices faster, and strengthen distributed commerce environments with confidence.
raw_blocks: Move faster with confidence across your tech stack

Modernize your edge computing and cloud POS systems without disrupting operations. Simplify complexity through a unified, microservices-based commerce platform built for distributed retail and restaurant performance.
Fragmented architectures create risk & drag

Legacy technology, siloed systems and point-solution complexity increase integration friction, slow release cycles, and increase operational risk. You’re under pressure to modernize and streamline these systems, but you can’t risk downtime or break mission-critical workflows.
Streamline your tech stack without sacrificing agility
Improve resilience and uptime, bolster security and reduce complexity while accelerating deployments and making integrations easier.
Compose a modular, future-ready stack
Build with microservices, open APIs and unified data models that allow you to integrate, extend and evolve.
Deploy and update at scale
Roll out applications and updates across locations in minutes—not months—through centralized, cloud-based application management.
Engineer security and resilience by design
Protect distributed environments with zero-trust architecture and edge-native safeguards built specifically for retail and restaurant operations.
NCR Voyix makes this possible through:
Microservices-based commerce applications with unified APIs and data models that simplify integrations
Intelligent app delivery and management with cloud-delivered services and cloud-managed edge applications
Edge-native runtime and a centralized control plane that enables distributed performance, uptime and resilience even during network disruptions
A flexible platform foundation with open integrations and ecosystem support
Future-proof your infrastructure with expert IT services
Our expert IT services help you maximize the value of your investments by identifying and evaluating opportunities for growth and innovation while ensuring limited downtime.
Resources to help you accelerate your business
Discover real-world insights, news and guidance.
How retailers should split workloads between cloud and edge for real-time store operations

What should run in the cloud, and what should run in the store? Match each workload to the environment it was built for. Real-time work belongs at the edge. That means POS transactions, shrink detection, video recognition and in-store promotions. These process locally and keep running even when connectivity drops. Use the cloud for the rest: offline data analysis, AI model training, big-data processing and eCommerce. So the answer is not “Cloud Out” or “Edge In.” It is both, built as one hybrid architecture.
When AI Places the Order: Agentic Commerce and the Restaurant
Soon the customer placing your next order may not be a person at all. It may be their AI agent. The restaurants that win will not have the flashiest AI. They will have the cleanest data
How to turn forecourt advertising into in-store sales with unified commerce
Turn gas station pump ads into in-store sales by connecting your forecourt, loyalty app and POS on one unified commerce platform. Here's how.
How to reduce shrink at self-checkout with visual AI

Retailers can reduce shrink at self-checkout without removing it from stores by deploying visual AI to eliminate the produce misidentification and PLU errors that quietly erode margins. Visual AI uses computer vision to identify items on the scanner scale automatically, catching both honest mistakes and fraudulent selections in real time.
